text_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the chunk text, or null when the chunk carries no text.

chunk_id.description: Chunk the quote came from, or null when the trace does not record one.

index_record_id.description: Index record the quote came from, or null when the trace does not record one.

quote_text.description: Verbatim quoted text as cited. Matching uses the PROJECT_BOOK §4.2 normalisation (NFC, LF, collapsed whitespace); case, punctuation and full/half-width differences are preserved.

display_record.description: What the display layer claims. viewer_page1 is the value actually handed to the PDF viewer and must be 1-based; when citation_page_basis is UNKNOWN, viewer_page1 must be null (no conversion is allowed).

citation_page_basis.description: What citation_page_value means. UNKNOWN means the source did not state its basis; the value must be kept verbatim and flagged UNKNOWN_PAGE_BASIS, never guessed.

citation_page_value.description: Raw page value as emitted by the external system. Integer for PDF_INDEX_0 / PDF_NUMBER_1, string for PDF_LABEL, any of the three (or null) for UNKNOWN. The value/basis type agreement is a runtime rule (docs/PAGE_SEMANTICS.md R-08).

viewer_page1.description: Page number handed to the viewer, 1-based, or null when unknown / not convertible. 0 is never valid.

then.description: UNKNOWN basis must not be converted: viewer_page1 is forced to null.

text_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the extracted page text (normalised form per PROJECT_BOOK §4.2), or null when text_state is not TEXT.

text_state.description: TEXT: extractable text present. EMPTY: blank page, honestly marked. IMAGE_ONLY: scanned/image page, no text layer. ERROR: extraction failed for this page.

page_index0.description: Physical PDF page index, 0-based. Range [0, page_count-1] is enforced at runtime against document.page_count (JSON Schema cannot compare two fields).

page_label.description: PDF page label string, e.g. 'i', 'iv', 'A-3'. Null when the PDF defines no label. Labels are looked up, never arithmetically converted (PROJECT_BOOK §4.1).

page_number1.description: Human 1-based physical page number. Strictly pdf_page_index0 + 1. Never computed from a label.

source_page_indices0.description: Physical PDF pages (0-based) a chunk / index record covers. Must be sorted ascending, de-duplicated, non-negative and in range at runtime; the schema enforces type, non-negativity and uniqueness, but not ordering (JSON Schema cannot express ordering).

description: PageTrace case bundle (P026, PROJECT_BOOK.md v1.0.0 §6.2-§6.3). Frozen by T001. Canonical page identity is pdf_page_index0 (0-based). A bare field named 'page' is forbidden anywhere: every object sets additionalProperties:false and 'page' is not a listed property, so any bare 'page' fails validation. Cross-field rules the schema cannot express (index < page_count, sorted source_page_indices0, basis/value type agreement, viewer_page1 recomputation) are runtime rules in docs/PAGE_SEMANTICS.md and are enforced by the analyzer, not by this schema.

citations.description: Citations to check. Each citation carries the quote text; the page value it claims lives in stages.display, never as a bare 'page'.

file_name.description: PDF file name only: a bare file name, no directory and no absolute path. Must not contain '/' or '\', must not start with a Windows drive letter (e.g. 'C:'), must not be a UNC path, and must not be '.' or '..' (R-11, FIX-R1 P1-R1-04).

page_count.description: Number of physical PDF pages. Must equal the real PDF page count. Maximum 500 is the PROJECT_BOOK §13 default refusal threshold.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact PDF bytes. Must match the real file or the run fails with INPUT_HASH_MISMATCH (PROJECT_BOOK §6.3).

schema.description: Schema identifier. Must match exactly; an unknown major version is rejected (PROJECT_BOOK §6.3).

stages.description: Stage snapshots. Each stage array is optional, but any absent stage MUST be listed in missing_stages; an empty array must never be passed off as 'stage checked and clean' (PROJECT_BOOK §6.3).

extraction.description: One record per physical PDF page, in pdf_page_index0 order.

missing_stages.description: Stages with no snapshot at all. Empty array means all four stages are present.
